evals.prompt: /rpi docs/intent.md (the intent asks for CSV export on the reports page; no spec.md or plan.md exists yet)
evals.expected_output: A research file with path:line citations, a drafted spec.md for the human to accept, then a phased plan.md, and a stop for plan approval before any code changes.
expectations: Writes docs/research/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md with path:line citations and no proposed fixes
Lists build/test/lint commands that match package.json or the Makefile
Drafts spec.md with acceptance criteria and asks the human to accept it
Writes plan.md with phases, each having automated and manual verification
Stops and asks for plan approval without editing source files

evals.prompt: /rpi continue. plan.md is approved, phase 1 is ticked, phase 2 is not.
evals.expected_output: Resumes at phase 2, runs its verification, ticks it and appends a PROGRESS.md entry before moving on.
expectations: Reads plan.md and PROGRESS.md before changing code
Runs phase 2's automated verification commands and reports their results
Ticks phase 2 in plan.md and appends a past-tense PROGRESS.md entry

evals.prompt: /rpi add rate limiting to the API (there is no docs/intent.md)
evals.expected_output: Asks the human for the intent or offers a draft for them to edit, instead of inventing goals and starting research.
expectations: Asks the human to write or approve an intent before planning
Does not write plan.md or change code

evals.prompt: /rpi continue. During phase 2 the planned file src/report/export.ts turns out to have been deleted upstream.
evals.expected_output: Stops, explains the mismatch, proposes a plan change and waits for approval.
expectations: Stops implementation when the code disagrees with the plan
Proposes a concrete edit to plan.md and records it under Plan changes after approval
Does not improvise a different design without approval

evals.prompt: /rpi continue. All phases are ticked and green.
evals.expected_output: Writes docs/review.md mapping acceptance criteria to evidence and hands off to a human without merging.
expectations: Writes docs/review.md with each spec.md acceptance criterion and its evidence
Lists deviations from the plan and what was not verified
Does not merge or mark the review approved
